title_as_printed: Pressure-Temperature-Composition Data in the Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Region in the NaCl-H2O System
pressure_note: saturation pressure of the two-phase NaCl-H2O system at the stated temperature, read on a digital pressure gauge (0.1 % full scale, +-0.7 kg/cm2); unit printed as kg/cm2 (kgf/cm2 assumed technical atmosphere; builder: 1 kg/cm2 = 0.980665 bar); pressure recorded immediately after sampling

value.what: saturation pressure of the two-phase NaCl-H2O system at T and the measured liquid composition (1 kg/cm2 = 0.980665 bar)

composition.other_species: pure water solvent; binary NaCl-H2O liquid phase; percent basis (mass percent assumed) is not stated explicitly in the paper

extra_unmapped: [NaCl]_v [%] (NaCl content of the steam phase, printed as mantissa and power of ten; basis not stated)
conversion_needs: liquid-phase [%] presumed mass percent; not stated (almost certainly mass percent: sample weighed and analysed for salt)
notes: Temperature printed only at first row of each isotherm block (ditto marks below); filled down in the CSV. Liquid composition is the measured quantity for each isotherm at the recorded saturation pressure. Last row of 380 C block: liquid printed as '42.' (truncated in print), vapour and K_D '-'. Rows 300-360 C: vapour not measured. Rows printed as '-' for 400 C 231.6 and 440 C 266.5 are rows with no vapour value.
